silhouette.reason: Horns, open jaw with teeth, dorsal spines, membrane wings with fingers and a long tail with a spade read from every view; the spade now reads in TOP and 3/4 REAR.
fixes: lift the tail tip in the idle pose so the spade also reads in hero.png

proportions.reason: Neck reads short and thick for the 8.9 m body, and the tail root is thinner than the hips in SIDE.
fixes: lengthen the neck chain by one vertebra (neck.ts); thicken the tail root to match the hips (tail.ts)

materials.reason: The scales are now plates with darker gaps between them over back, flanks and legs, so they read less as leopard spots; they are still large rounded blobs that look like cobbles, and membrane and hide share one sheen.
fixes: smaller overlapping plates with a clear down-slope overlap on the neck and flanks

detail.reason: Teeth, spines, wing fingers, claws and belly plates hold; the spot pattern now covers the trunk, but there is no relief between the spots.
fixes: shallow relief on the scale rows on the neck and back

wear.reason: Ragged membrane edges and a sooty snout remain, and the white rib-like shoulder stripes became short dark slash scars (hero.png, shoulder); the slashes are faint at hero distance and the horn tips are intact.
fixes: slash scars a little lighter and raised so they read at hero distance

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 keeps wings, horns and colour blocks and now shades smoothly; but its even red-orange body is lighter than the dark plated LOD0, so the value pops at the switch.
fixes: darken the LOD2 body vertex colour to the LOD0 plate average
more rings on the LOD2 tail and neck

technical.reason: QA clean; 149.0k / 28.0k / 4.0k tris, 7 / 7 / 7 draws: LOD0 is heavier than the detail it shows.
fixes: cap LOD0 near 120k by coarsening the hidden belly and inner-leg sculpt cells
